Clear aligner treatment

Invisible orthodontics in Sète: what the assessment should clarify

Clear aligners can help with some tooth movements, but they are not suitable for every case and are not completely invisible.

Contact the practice
English

This is an informational translation. The practice has not confirmed that consultations can be conducted in English. Please contact the practice to arrange communication.

01

Suitability

The dentist examines tooth position, bite, gums and the movements required before discussing aligners or alternatives.

02

Daily commitment

Aligners usually require disciplined wear, removal for meals, careful cleaning and regular monitoring. Attachments may be visible.

03

Retention and limits

Retention is normally required after active movement. No simulation or treatment plan can guarantee a specific result.

Informations générales : aucun contenu ne remplace un examen clinique.
